plugins.name: cli-patch-mods
plugins.description: Function-hook alternative to 9 of this repo's byte patches

plugins.name: own-bash-edit-notice
plugins.description: Cut the 'changed on disk' notice to one line when the session's own Bash command changed the file

plugins.name: session-autocompact
plugins.description: /session-autocompact: auto-compact this session only, between turns, once context passes a threshold

plugins.name: keystroke
plugins.description: /keystroke: compose replies through type/backspace/send tool calls, a few characters per call; the reply still lands as a normal assistant message

plugins.name: prompt-queue
plugins.description: /queue and /hqueue: hold a prompt until Claude is idle (hqueue: also until background jobs finish), listed in a band above the input

plugins.name: progress
plugins.description: /progress: ask "how is it going? anything i should know?" as a side question, like /btw, answered in a band above the input
